title: Loom Usage Record v1
description: Request-level ledger row. Appended to .loom/ledger/requests.jsonl; aggregates are recomputed from raw rows.

run_id.description: Run the request belongs to; absent means unattributed.

task_id.description: Task the request belongs to; absent counts as unattributed.

attempt.description: Retry/fallback sequence number within the same task; one row per request.

model_alias.description: Model alias from config, used for routing reconciliation.

model_id.description: Real provider model id; do not reconcile on the alias alone.

wire.description: Wire protocol used by the request; determines gateway/billing coverage.

input_tokens.description: Normalized total input tokens, including cached_input_tokens.

cached_input_tokens.description: Cache-hit input tokens; must be <= input_tokens.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens; usually included in output_tokens, diagnostic only, not billed twice.

cost_usd.description: Actual or estimated cost; the source is marked by cost_source.

cost_source.description: Provider billing takes precedence; pricing_table means a local capability-bit estimate.

source.description: Source of the usage data; priority provider > litellm > runtime > headroom.

status.description: HTTP/provider status; >= 400 counts as a failed request.

step.description: 1-based step number within the run; may be omitted for one-shot requests.

tool_names.description: Tool names the model called at this step.

write_paths.description: Paths written as whole files at this step (edit does not count).

rewrite_count.description: Number of repeated whole-file overwrites of already-written files at this step.

history_bytes.description: Serialized history size in bytes before projection.
